description: Principles and practices of communicating science to diverse audiences. Covers the CER (claims-evidence-reasoning) framework, lab report structure, peer review, scientific argumentation, audience adaptation, the baloney detection kit for evaluating sources, and the art of making complex ideas accessible without sacrificing accuracy. Use when writing, presenting, evaluating, or teaching science communication at any level.
